description: Source file implementing the mac_test_mode_ue_repository class for managing test mode UEs in a MAC layer, including functions for adding, removing, and querying UEs based on RNTI and configuration requests.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_ue_repository
classes.description: Repository class for managing test mode User Equipment (UE) in MAC layer, handling UE addition, removal, and lookup based on RNTI.

methods.name: get_cell_index
methods.description: Calculates the cell index based on RNTI.

methods.name: rnti_to_du_ue_idx
methods.description: Converts RNTI to DU UE index.

methods.name: get_sched_ue_cfg_request
methods.description: Retrieves scheduling configuration request for a given RNTI.

methods.name: find_sched_ue_cfg_request
methods.description: Finds scheduling configuration request for a given RNTI, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: is_msg4_rxed
methods.description: Checks if message 4 has been received for a given RNTI.

methods.name: msg4_rxed
methods.description: Marks message 4 as received or not for a given RNTI.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the repository, scheduling creation on the appropriate cell thread.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository, scheduling removal on the appropriate cell thread.
